sql: with o as (select market_ticker, strategy, bool_or(status='filled') as filled, max(limit_price) as px, sum(case when status='filled' then quantity else 0 end) as qty from live_orders where strategy in ('Nmmsell10','Kmmsell10') and created_at >= '2026-10-16 14:11' group by 1,2), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), tw as (select sum(case when status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') then 1 else 0 end) as tw_settled, sum(case when status='open' then 1 else 0 end) as tw_open, round(sum(coalesce(pnl,0))::numeric,2) as tw_pnl from paper_trades where strategy='Nmmsell10_pt4') select o.strategy, count(*) filter (where filled) as filled_mkts, sum(qty) as contracts, count(*) filter (where filled and p.pos=0) as settled, count(*) filter (where filled and p.pos=0 and p.realized_pnl<0) as losers, count(*) filter (where filled and coalesce(p.pos,0)<>0) as open_mkts, count(*) filter (where filled and o.market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o where strategy='Kmmsell10' and filled) and o.market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o where strategy='Nmmsell10' and filled)) as shared, max(tw.tw_settled) as twin_settled, max(tw.tw_open) as twin_open, max(tw.tw_pnl) as twin_pnl from o left join p using (market_ticker) cross join tw group by 1 order by 1
